          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.

          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

I implemented create-time telephone normalization for `POST /api/owners` so the input is stripped to digits and required to be exactly 10.
